name: sproutbook
description: 像素风植物养护管理应用 / A pixel-art plant care manager
author: Sproutbook contributors

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.dist: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
